campaign.name: REP WITH ME
campaign.tagline: Let's make life sexy again. One rep at a time.
campaign.promise: Every day the app drops a new rep. Every day I do it with you, on camera, out loud, and a little ridiculous. You are not doing your life alone.
campaign.north_star: 10,000 reps done together by Dec 31 (tracked as public 'IN' comments + story tags + app completions).

architecture: The frameworks, models and tools behind everything: how we think, feel, decide, act, relate and lead. Mission: the way we think, feel and respond are skills we can learn, strengthen and practice.
Daily AI practice coach, the Daily Rep / Dare, courses, live sessions and community, tools for the moment. Houses Academy, InnerLab, INQ Certification and IOS.
The culture, language, merch and sense of belonging. For the people doing the work. EST. 2026.
Courses to own: Money, Purpose, Health, Spiritual, Teens, Work, Young Adult, Transitions, Grief, Relationships.
Coach the change that actually changes people.
The people operating system for organizations.
coreLines: You get one life. Let's get good at living it.
Life takes reps. Better takes practice.
For the people doing the work.
Bring one thing. Let's start there.
Life doesn't come with a manual. Now you have a Practice.
You don't need a different life, just a new way to meet this one.
appRhythm: Who do you choose to be today?
A new rep every day. One small thing to do before the day ends.
Your three, and who you wanted to be.
One hour to bed. Screens down when you're ready.
Notice what went well, what you learned, what you're ready to let go of.
Sixty minutes that decide the next seven days.

Before you answer one message today, take one full breath first.
Tell someone exactly what you appreciate about them, in one sentence.
Give yourself five minutes with something you genuinely enjoy. No need to make it productive.
At the end of today, pick one ordinary moment you would gladly experience again.
Ask someone you care about how they are doing, and give their answer a little room.

visual.palette: Warm ivory / cream, deep navy, antique gold accents, forest green for Practice moments. Never heavy pink.
visual.type: Fraunces-style serif headlines, clean sans body, gold italic for one emphasised phrase.
visual.feel: Premium collegiate club meets golden-hour lifestyle. Confident, warm, a little cheeky. Premium in experience, inclusive in spirit.
visual.merch: The Practice Club Tee (cream), The Club Hoodie (cream), Life Takes Reps Cap (navy), The Monogram Hoodie (navy).

guardrails: Show the real app. Screen-record real reps and real coaching. Never fake an AI response and present it as real.
No unverified claims: no trial offers, pricing, outcomes or testimonials without approval and permission.
No em dashes in on-screen text or captions (brand rule from the Suite brief).
Sexy means alive, confident, present and fun. Never body-shaming, never thirst-trap. Life is the sexy part.
Grief, money and hard-season reps get warmth, not jokes. Read the room on the day.

Mon.name: REP DROP
Mon.why: Kick off the week. Show the app, read the rep, react, do it, invite. The signature format.

Tue.name: REP IN THE WILD
Tue.why: Do the rep out in real life: coffee shop, office, car line, grocery store. Candid, funny, proof it fits a normal day.

Wed.name: WHY THIS REP WORKS
Wed.why: The InnerBoard thinking behind the rep. Built to be saved and DM'd to a rep partner.

Thu.name: REP DUET
Thu.why: Do the rep with a guest (friend, client, teammate, family). Invite them as a Collaborator so it hits both audiences.

Fri.name: ROLL CALL
Fri.why: Celebrate the Rep Crew by name. Their stories, comments and DMs are the content. Being seen is the reward.

Sat.name: LIFE LOOKS GOOD
Sat.why: Make life sexy. Golden-hour, merch, joy, the ordinary moment made beautiful. Reach beyond the growth crowd.

Sun.name: SET THE WEEK
Sun.fmt: IG Live + Facebook Group Live, 20 min; then a 30s clip
Sun.why: Mirrors the app's Sunday 'Set the Week'. Live with the crew, preview the week, pick one rep together.

A.name: Kitchen Counter
tips: Phone on tripod at eye level, vertical 9:16, 4K 30fps, back camera (use a flip mirror or the Edits app preview).
Face a window, light at 45 degrees. Cream wall or open shelves behind you. Gold mug or flowers in frame.
Clip-on mic (DJI Mic or similar). Frame chest-up with headroom for captions.
Talk to one person in the lens. First line within the first second, no 'hey guys'.

B.name: Car Confessional
tips: Parked. Phone on dash or vent mount, facing a side window for soft light.
Best for raw, honest reps and 'I almost didn't do this one' energy. Engine off, AC off for sound.

C.name: In the Wild
tips: Handheld at arm's length, 1x lens (0.5x distorts faces), or hand the phone to a friend.
Grab 3 shots: you arriving (wide), you doing the rep (medium), your reaction after (close).
Wind muff on the mic outdoors. Ask permission before filming anyone's face; film hands, backs or reactions otherwise.

D.name: App POV
tips: Screen-record the real Practice app: notification, Today's Rep screen, the tap to complete (Control Center > Screen Recording).
Plus an over-the-shoulder shot of your thumb opening the notification with coffee in the other hand.
Always real app footage. Never simulate a coaching response.

E.name: Golden Hour Lifestyle
tips: The hour before sunset. Shoot 6-10 B-roll clips of 3-5 seconds each; 60fps for slow motion.
Wear the merch (Club Hoodie, Life Takes Reps cap). Movement in every clip: walking, laughing, pouring, spinning.
Edit to a trending audio in the Edits app or CapCut; one line of on-screen text, no talking needed.

F.name: Two-Shot Duet
tips: Two people on a couch or at the counter. Phone vertical, a step further back, both faces in frame.
Two mics if you have them. Film the 'before rep' take and the 'after rep' take for contrast.
Add the guest as a Collaborator when posting.

G.name: Carousel Design
tips: Canva template, 1080x1350 (4:5). Cream background, navy serif headline, one gold italic phrase per slide.
Slide 1 is the hook. Slide 6 asks for the send. Slide 7 is the end card. Max 25 words a slide.
Batch these on Sunday afternoons: they don't depend on the morning's rep.

H.name: Live
tips: Phone on tripod, light in front of you, quiet room. Go Live on Instagram; a second phone runs Facebook Group Live (or go live in the Group right after).
20 minutes: 3 min welcome + wins, 7 min the week's theme, 7 min pick and do a rep together live, 3 min invite.
Save the replay. Cut the best 30s into Monday's story and the Facebook Group.

routine: Screenshot the app's Today's Rep. Add an 'Add Yours' sticker with the rep text and a poll: 'You in?' IN / Tomorrow. Add a question box: 'Who do you choose to be today?' Send the rep to the IG Broadcast Channel (The Rep Crew).
Post the rep as the day's thread in The Practice Club: Rep Room. 'Today's rep: ___. Who's in? Drop IN.'
Film today's anchor post using the day's setup and shot list. If the app's rep is different from the backup rep below, use the app's rep. The format works for any rep.
Publish the anchor post at the series time. Crosspost Reels to Facebook Reels. Pin the best comment.
Reply to every comment. Heart and cheer every IN. DM the link to anyone who asks. Comment thoughtfully on 5 creators from the intel list and 5 Rep Crew members.
Raw behind-the-scenes of you actually doing the rep. No polish. Tag #RepWithMe.
Reshare every Rep Crew tag and Add Yours entry. Question box: 'Your three: what went well today?' Mirrors the app's Close the Day.
Design Wednesday's carousel, line up Thursday's duet guest, pick Saturday's location and outfit, log last week's numbers in the tracker.
funRules: React honestly when you read the rep. 'Oh, this one's spicy' is better than a lesson.
Exaggerate the human moment: the most dramatic breath, the longest pause, the biggest no.
Let the app be a character. 'My app is bossing me around again.'
Always end with the invitation, never the lecture: 'Do it with me. Comment IN.'
Same closing line every day so it becomes a chant: 'Life takes reps. See you tomorrow.'
growth: Every anchor post ends with 'Comment IN'. Use a Meta-approved DM automation tool (ManyChat or Meta's built-in auto-replies) to DM the app link to every IN. Confirm the Practice app URL first.
IG Broadcast Channel: The Rep Crew
One message every morning with the rep and a voice note. The most loyal 1% live here.
Facebook Group: The Practice Club, Rep Room
Daily rep thread, Sunday Live, Friday wins thread. Moms of teens and practice owners are on Facebook.
The rep travels follower to follower through the Add Yours sticker every morning.
Four guests a month, each posting to their audience. Start with clients you're already inviting to Supercharge in Fort Lauderdale.
Each month one Rep Crew member gets a Life Takes Reps cap, announced on the last Friday. Gives people a reason to tag you.
Cut your Dr. Pat Show episodes into 30-45s clips with a hook line on screen. One per week as a bonus post.
Track IN comments + story tags + app completions. Show the running total every Friday. Road to 10,000 reps.

platform: Instagram's head has repeatedly named watch time, sends per reach and likes per reach as the core Reels signals. Build every post so someone wants to DM it to a friend: 'Send this to your rep partner.'
Hook as on-screen text AND spoken line in the first beat. A short reel watched twice beats a long one abandoned halfway. Aim for 15-40s on Rep With Me reels.

2026 benchmark reporting shows carousels roughly matching or slightly beating Reels on follower engagement, while Reels still lead on reach for accounts under 50K. Run both: Reels for reach, carousels for the crew.
Recurring, named series (Rep With Me, Rep in the Wild, Roll Call) train people to come back. Same opening line, same end card, every day.
Use Instagram Trial Reels to test two hooks for the same rep with non-followers before sharing to your grid. Keep the winner's hook style.
Reply to every comment in the first 60 minutes. Answer 'IN' comments with a heart and a one-line cheer. That is the community, not a chore.
Crosspost every reel to Facebook Reels, but put the real energy into a Facebook Group (The Practice Club: Rep Room). Moms of teens and practice owners live there and comment in paragraphs.
Every morning story uses an 'Add Yours' sticker with today's rep, so the rep travels from follower to follower.

days.rep: Say no to one thing today that you'd usually say yes to out of habit.
days.title: Welcome to Rep With Me
days.hook_text: I'm doing my life's reps out loud. Come do them with me.
days.hook_spoken: Every morning my app gives me one rep for my life. Starting today, I'm doing it with you.
beats: Open on the real app notification (screen record). 'Here she is. Today's rep.'
Read the rep out loud. React honestly: 'Ooh. Out of HABIT. That's personal.'
Say the real thing you're saying no to today, on camera.
'I don't want to do my life alone. I want company. People who are excited about their one life.'
Invite: 'Your turn. Comment IN and tell me what you're saying no to.' Close: 'Life takes reps. See you tomorrow.'
shots: Close-up as you say your no
End card: REP WITH ME / Life takes reps.
days.caption:
Starting today I'm not doing my life alone.

Every morning the Practice app gives me one rep. One small thing that makes this one life a little better. And every day I'm going to do it with you, out loud, probably a little ridiculous.

Today's rep: say no to one thing you'd usually say yes to out of habit.

Mine is ___. What's yours? Comment IN and I'll send you the app.

Life takes reps. Let's make life sexy again. #RepWithMe #LifeTakesReps #ThePracticeClub
days.extras: BONUS: also post Master Script 01 'You Get One Life' tonight and pin it to your grid. Announce the Facebook Group in Stories.

days.rep: Before you answer one message today, take one full breath first.
days.title: The Most Dramatic Breath of My Life
days.hook_text: Watch me not reply to this text for one full breath.
days.hook_spoken: Someone just texted me something annoying and today's rep says I have to breathe first.
beats: Phone buzzes on the café table. You glare at it.
Text on screen: 'Today's rep: one full breath before you answer.'
The most over-the-top, slow-motion, eyes-closed breath of your life. Hold it. Café sounds.
Type the calmer reply. 'Huh. That's a different text than I was going to send.'
'One breath. That's the whole rep. Comment IN if you're doing it with me.'
shots: Wide: you at a café with coffee
days.caption:
The text I almost sent vs the text I sent after one breath. 😅

Today's rep: before you answer one message today, take one full breath first.

That's it. One breath. It's the smallest gap between reacting and choosing.

Comment IN if you're doing it with me. Tell me later how it went. #RepWithMe #LifeTakesReps
days.extras: Trial Reel test: Hook A 'Watch me not reply to this text' vs Hook B 'The text I almost sent'.

days.rep: Tell someone exactly what you appreciate about them, in one sentence.
days.title: The One-Sentence Rep
days.hook_text: The one-sentence rep that changes a relationship.
beats: Slide 1: The one-sentence rep that changes a relationship.
Slide 2: Vague: 'You're the best.' Exact: 'The way you remembered my mom's surgery made me feel held.'
Slide 3: Why exact works: specific is how people know they were actually seen.
Slide 4: Fill in the blank: 'I appreciate the way you ___ because ___.'
Slide 5: Leah's real one (screenshot of the text you sent, name blurred).
Slide 6: Send this to the person you're about to appreciate. 😉
Slide 7: Today's rep. Life takes reps. Comment IN.
shots: Screenshot your actual appreciation text for slide 5
days.caption:
Most of us appreciate people in our heads and never say it out loud.

Today's rep: tell someone exactly what you appreciate about them, in one sentence. Exact, not nice.

Save this for the template. Send it to the person you're about to text. Comment IN when you've done it. #RepWithMe #ThePracticeClub

days.title: Good. Great! (Take 2)
days.hook_text: We ask 'how are you' 20 times a day. Here's what happens when you actually wait.
beats: Take 1 (fast, comedic): 'How are you?' 'Good.' 'Great!' Both walk off. Text: 'Every conversation ever.'
Take 2: Leah asks again, then just waits. Holds eye contact. Three full seconds of silence.
Guest actually answers something real (let it be real, keep it light).
Text on screen: 'The rep is the pause.'
Both to camera: 'Do it with us. Comment IN. Then go ask someone and wait.'
days.caption:
The rep isn't the question. It's the pause after it.

days.rep: Before you correct your kid (or your partner), ask one curious question first.
days.title: Reps Over Regret: Say This, Not That
days.hook_text: Before you correct your teenager, try this one question.
beats: Slide 1: Before you correct your teenager, try one question.
Slide 2: Instead of 'Why would you do that?' try 'What were you hoping would happen?'
Slide 3: Instead of 'You never listen' try 'What's making this hard right now?'
Slide 4: Why: fear sounds like anger when we skip curiosity. (Brand reason 3)
Slide 5: You can't control every choice they make. You can practice how you respond.
Slide 6: Send this to the mom friend who needs it today.
Slide 7: Today's rep. Reps over regret. Comment IN.

days.rep: Do the thing you told yourself you'd do 'tomorrow'. Just the first five minutes.

days.hook_text: I've been avoiding this for three weeks. Doing it on camera right now.
beats: App POV: read today's rep. Groan.
Name the thing you've been putting off (real).

Timer ends: 'That's evidence. I can trust myself a little more today.'
'Your five minutes. Comment IN.'
shots: Talking head close for the payoff
days.caption:
Confidence doesn't come first. Evidence does.

days.rep: Make one decision today you've been waiting to 'feel ready' for.
days.title: Decision in the Wild
days.hook_text: I made the decision I've been 'not ready' for. Here's how.
beats: At the office or in the car. 'I've been waiting to feel ready. Today's rep says decide anyway.'
Three quick steps on screen: What do I know. What can I influence. What's my next move.
Make the decision (send the email, book the thing).
'Feeling ready is optional. Comment IN.'
days.caption:
You don't have to feel ready to begin. You can practice beginning.

Today's rep: make one decision you've been waiting to feel ready for.

Comment IN. #RepWithMe #LifeTakesReps

days.rep: Write down one thing you complain about every week. Then write one move that's yours to make.
days.title: What Are You Tolerating?
days.hook_text: What are you tolerating right now?
beats: Slide 1: What are you tolerating right now?
Slide 2: The employee who isn't following through. The schedule. The conversation you keep avoiding.
Slide 3: We spend hours complaining about things we actually have some influence over.
Slide 4: Two columns: 'What I complain about' / 'The move that's mine'.
Slide 5: Have the conversation. Make the request. Set the expectation. Make the decision.
Slide 6: Send this to the founder friend carrying everything.
Slide 7: Leadership starts with how you lead yourself. Comment IN.
days.caption:
Leadership starts with how you lead yourself.

Today's rep: write down one thing you complain about every week. Then write one move that's yours to make.

Comment IN. Send to the founder friend who needs it. #RepWithMe #ThePracticeClub

days.rep: Hand off one decision you'd usually make yourself, and let your person own it.

days.hook_text: A practice owner and I did today's rep with her team.
beats: Two-shot with a founder or practice-owner client.
Take 1: team member asks a question, owner answers instantly (comedic, the usual).
Take 2: owner asks 'What do you think we should do?' and waits.

days.caption:
